author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 让一个词找到自己的轨道
prompt_zh: 做一条 12 秒动态字体短片，核心词是「方向」。黑色背景上只使用一种无衬线字体和橙色圆点。0–3 秒让词从一条细线中长出来；3–7 秒让每个字母沿同一条椭圆轨道错开运动；7–10 秒轨道收缩成一个点；10–12 秒恢复成完整单词。每个镜头内部都要有可读的运动，不能靠随机粒子填充。画面按 render(t) 重现，固定 60fps，16:9，配一段轻微的合成脉冲音。先导出关键帧，再导出 MP4。
prompt_en: Create a 12-second kinetic type film around the word “direction”. Use one sans-serif typeface, a black field and orange dots. From 0–3s the word grows from a thin line; from 3–7s each letter travels along the same ellipse with staggered timing; from 7–10s the orbit contracts into one point; from 10–12s the word returns intact. Every shot needs readable internal motion, with no random particle filler. Make each frame reproducible from render(t), at 60fps and 16:9, with a restrained synthesized pulse. Render keyframes before the MP4.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_en: Fold a sheet into an interface
prompt_zh: 做一条 15 秒奶油白背景的纸艺动效。一个橙色矩形像纸张一样沿真实折痕翻折，依次变成搜索框、列表和确认卡片。每次折叠都保留上一状态的一条边，让观众理解形状如何变成界面。0–4 秒平面展开；4–9 秒两次折叠；9–13 秒卡片被轻推入画面；13–15 秒停在完整界面。不要使用渐变、玻璃拟态或无意义的弹跳。固定透视和阴影参数，输出 1920×1080 60fps，并保留可定位的时间线。
prompt_en: Make a 15-second paper-motion study on a warm cream field. An orange rectangle folds along visible creases and becomes a search field, a list and a confirmation card. Each fold must preserve one edge of the previous state so the transformation is understandable. 0–4s: unfold the sheet; 4–9s: two folds; 9–13s: push the card into place; 13–15s: hold the complete interface. No gradients, glassmorphism or meaningless bounce. Keep perspective and shadow parameters fixed, render 1920x1080 at 60fps and preserve a seekable timeline.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一条 10 秒抽象动效，解释“逐级增强”。画面只有 8 级黑色阶梯、一条橙色信号线和一个数值标签。信号线从左下角出发，每经过一级就留下短暂的亮痕；第 6 秒到达顶端后，所有亮痕按相反顺序熄灭。线的位置、标签数值和声音峰值必须由同一个时间表决定。使用固定缓动，不使用噪声和随机颜色。交付双语字幕、16 帧分镜和 1080p MP4。
prompt_en: Create a 10-second abstract motion piece about incremental gain. Use only eight charcoal steps, one orange signal line and a numeric label. The line starts at the lower left; each step leaves a brief glow; at 6s it reaches the top and the glows extinguish in reverse order. Drive the line, number and audio peaks from one fixed timeline. Use deterministic easing, no noise and no random colors. Deliver bilingual captions, a 16-frame storyboard and a 1080p MP4.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一条 14 秒产品感动效，展示一个光标如何把灰度画布变成有层次的橙色构图。前 4 秒光标沿网格移动并点亮节点；4–9 秒节点按点击顺序连接成三条路径；9–12 秒光标回到起点，路径变成三块标签；12–14 秒所有元素对齐。光标动作必须解释画面变化，不能只是装饰。保持 12 列网格、同一字号和一个强调色，提供可拖动时间线与无声版本。
prompt_en: Create a 14-second product-like motion study showing a cursor turning a grayscale canvas into an orange composition. During 0–4s the cursor moves over a grid and lights nodes; 4–9s the nodes connect in click order into three paths; 9–12s the cursor returns and the paths become three labels; 12–14s everything aligns. Cursor actions must explain the change, not decorate it. Keep a 12-column grid, one type scale and one accent color. Provide a seekable timeline and a silent version.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_en: Compress an archive into a circle
prompt_zh: 做一条 18 秒编辑式动态海报。12 条短句先以规整的两列文字出现，每条句子都有编号；随后它们按编号旋转到同一个圆周，形成一个可读的环形目录。第 12 秒圆周停止，中心出现一句结论，最后 3 秒只保留中心句和日期。字距、编号和圆周半径固定，旋转速度由句子数量决定。不要伪造引文或数据，使用项目提供的文本。
prompt_en: Create an 18-second editorial motion poster. Twelve short statements appear in two ordered columns, each numbered; they then rotate by number onto one circle, forming a readable circular index. At 12s the circle stops, a conclusion appears in the center, and the final 3s hold only the conclusion and date. Keep tracking, numbering and radius fixed; derive rotation speed from the item count. Do not invent quotations or data; use the project text supplied to the scene.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一条 16 秒动态字体实验，主题是“重量”。同一个词经历纸张、金属和橡胶三种材质，但字形、位置和语言不变。0–5 秒纸张轻微弯曲；5–10 秒金属字下沉并留下硬阴影；10–14 秒橡胶字压扁后回弹；14–16 秒回到原始平面。材料变化必须由可解释的几何和缓动表现，不能使用写实纹理。配低频、金属点击和短促回弹音，声音按镜头事件对齐。
prompt_en: Create a 16-second kinetic type experiment about weight. The same word passes through paper, metal and rubber while its glyphs, position and language stay constant. 0–5s: paper bends lightly; 5–10s: metal sinks with a hard shadow; 10–14s: rubber compresses and rebounds; 14–16s: return to the flat start. Express materials through explainable geometry and easing, not photoreal textures. Use a low tone, a metal click and a short rebound cue aligned to shot events.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 令牌桶：允许突发，控制速率
title_en: Token bucket: allow bursts, cap the rate
prompt_zh: 用 20 秒解释令牌桶限流。画面包含容量有限的桶、连续补充的令牌、请求队列和允许/限流两条路径。先让桶装满并通过 4 个请求，再在令牌不足时拒绝请求，最后调高补充速度让状态恢复。每帧从固定事件表和时间 t 重算，拖动时间线不能改变历史结果。容量、补充速度、令牌数和计数器始终一致。字幕说明这是演示模型，不是生产监控。
prompt_en: Explain a token bucket rate limiter in 20 seconds. Show a bounded bucket, continuously refilling tokens, a request queue and allow/limit paths. Fill the bucket and pass four requests, reject requests below one token, then raise refill speed and show recovery. Recompute each frame from a fixed event table and time t; seeking must not change history. Keep capacity, refill, tokens and counters consistent. Caption it as a demonstration model, not production monitoring.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: Debounce 等待最后一次输入
title_en: Debounce waits for the final input
prompt_zh: 用 16 秒解释 debounce。左侧是连续输入事件，右侧是一个被延迟的执行点。0–5 秒快速输入让计时器不断重置；5–9 秒停顿后只执行一次；9–13 秒出现第二组输入；13–16 秒用时间轴总结“输入、等待窗口、执行”。事件间距使用明确的 0.2、0.4、0.8 秒示例，标出它们不是实时用户数据。不要把 debounce 与 throttle 混为一谈。
prompt_en: Explain debounce in 16 seconds. Show a stream of input events on the left and one delayed execution point on the right. During 0–5s rapid input keeps resetting the timer; 5–9s a pause allows one execution; 9–13s a second burst appears; 13–16s summarize input, wait window and execution on one timeline. Use explicit 0.2, 0.4 and 0.8-second gaps and label them as examples, not live user data. Do not conflate debounce with throttle.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 向量搜索如何找到相近内容
title_en: How vector search finds nearby meaning
prompt_zh: 用 24 秒做一个不夸大的向量搜索示意。把三个文档和一个查询放进二维平面，用距离线展示相似度；查询先靠近两个相关文档，再改变一个词后移动到另一簇。画面明确二维平面只是示意，真实向量维度更高。分镜包含：输入文本、向量化、距离比较、返回排序。不要把距离图解释成理解或事实判断。
prompt_en: Create a careful 24-second visual explainer for vector search. Place three documents and one query in a 2D plane and use distance lines to show similarity; after one word changes, move the query toward another cluster. Label the 2D plane as a schematic because real embeddings have more dimensions. Shots: text input, vectorization, distance comparison and ranked results. Do not present distance as human understanding or a factual judgment.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 用 18 秒解释梯度下降的直觉。一个橙色小球在标有损失值的简化曲线上移动，每一步都显示当前点、局部斜率和更新后的点。前半段步长较大，后半段步长变小；最后停在局部低点并标注“不是保证全局最优”。曲线、步长和数值由同一组固定参数计算，禁止让球穿过曲线或凭空跳点。
prompt_en: Explain the intuition of gradient descent in 18 seconds. An orange dot moves on a simplified loss curve labeled with values; each step shows the current point, local slope and updated point. Use larger steps in the first half and smaller steps in the second, ending at a local low point labeled “not guaranteed globally optimal.” Compute the curve, steps and numbers from one fixed configuration. Never let the dot leave the curve or jump without an update.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 用 14 秒解释缓存命中。画面有客户端、缓存和慢速数据库三列。第一次请求穿过缓存到数据库并把结果存入；第二次请求在缓存处快速返回；第三次请求因键过期再次访问数据库。每个请求都有相同的编号和颜色，路径速度用于表达延迟差异。显式标注这是时间示意，不是真实毫秒测量。
prompt_en: Explain a cache hit in 14 seconds with three columns: client, cache and slower database. The first request passes through to the database and stores a result; the second returns quickly from cache; a third request misses because its key expired and visits the database again. Keep request IDs and colors consistent. Use path speed to communicate relative latency and label it as a timing schematic, not measured milliseconds.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 用 20 秒解释流式系统的背压。生产者、有限队列和消费者保持固定位置。先让生产速度超过消费速度，队列填满并向生产者返回暂停信号；随后消费者加速，队列降低，生产者恢复。每帧显示队列长度和两条速率线，使用固定数字 8、4、6 作为演示速率。强调这是模型，不宣称模拟了真实系统。
prompt_en: Explain backpressure in a streaming system in 20 seconds. Keep producer, bounded queue and consumer in fixed positions. First let production exceed consumption until the queue fills and sends a pause signal; then speed up the consumer, lower the queue and resume production. Show queue length and two rate lines every frame, using 8, 4 and 6 as demonstration rates. State clearly that this is a model, not a simulation of a real system.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一条 15 秒抽象 3D 场景：透明玻璃树上长出 24 个橙色球体。相机从低处缓慢升高，球体从后到前依次亮起，最后一束光穿过树冠投下椭圆阴影。使用固定的环面树枝、正交相机和三种材质参数；不要依赖物理模拟或随机散布。画面清楚展示深度层次，最后停留 1 秒让观众看清结构。
prompt_en: Create a 15-second abstract 3D scene: 24 orange spheres grow on a transparent glass tree. A camera rises slowly from below; spheres light from back to front, then one beam passes through the canopy and casts an ellipse shadow. Use fixed torus-like branches, an orthographic camera and three material parameters; avoid physics simulation and random scattering. Make depth layers readable and hold the final structure for one second.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_en: A modular city opens a route
prompt_zh: 做一条 18 秒等距 3D 城市场景。32 个建筑模块组成一个封闭方格，橙色路线从入口进入，经过的模块向两侧平移形成街道。路线经过后模块回到原位，但路线保留为细线。相机只做一次 20 度旋转，建筑高度来自固定数组。不要添加无法解释的车辆和人物，重点是路线如何改变空间。
prompt_en: Create an 18-second isometric city scene. Thirty-two building modules form a closed grid; an orange route enters and the modules it crosses slide apart to form a street. After the route passes, modules return while the route remains as a thin line. Use one 20-degree camera rotation and a fixed height array. Do not add unexplained vehicles or characters; the subject is how a route changes space.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一条 20 秒可视化装置动画。一个半透明圆筒里有一圈蓝色液面和三个橙色浮标。液面按正弦曲线升降，浮标随液面上下运动，齿轮每次到达峰值时转动 90 度。使用可见的刻度和时间标签，说明这是数学示意而非流体模拟。相机固定，所有形变由同一周期函数决定。
prompt_en: Create a 20-second visualization of a mechanical tide device. Inside a translucent cylinder, a blue surface and three orange floats rise and fall. The surface follows a sine function; floats follow it; gears rotate 90 degrees whenever the surface reaches a peak. Show a scale and time label, calling this a mathematical schematic rather than fluid simulation. Keep the camera fixed and derive every deformation from one periodic function.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一条 16 秒黑色背景的行星馆动画。一个橙色小球沿三条不同半径的轨道运行，轨道以细线呈现，文字标签显示半径比例 1、2、3。前 5 秒建立中心与轨道，5–12 秒让三个球错开形成节奏，12–16 秒镜头拉远显示完整结构。所有速度固定，不能把视觉距离解读成真实比例。
prompt_en: Create a 16-second planetarium on a black field. One orange sphere travels on each of three orbital radii, drawn as thin lines with labels showing radius ratios 1, 2 and 3. During 0–5s establish center and orbits; 5–12s offset the three spheres into a rhythm; 12–16s pull back to reveal the structure. Keep speeds fixed and label the visual distances as illustrative, not physical scale.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_en: The center of mass of a ceramic tower
prompt_zh: 做一条 17 秒几何 3D 动画。六个暖白陶瓷圆柱叠成略微倾斜的塔，橙色竖线显示重心投影。前 6 秒逐层堆叠，6–11 秒塔缓慢偏移但投影仍在底面内，11–14 秒偏移超过底面并倒下，14–17 秒以对齐姿态重置。用标签说明这是静力学示意，动作要慢而清楚。
prompt_en: Create a 17-second geometric 3D animation. Six warm-white ceramic cylinders stack into a slightly leaning tower; an orange line shows the projected center of mass. Build layer by layer for 0–6s; shift slowly for 6–11s while the projection stays inside the base; exceed the base and fall during 11–14s; reset aligned for 14–17s. Label it as a statics schematic and keep the motion slow and legible.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一条 14 秒抽象日晷动画。一个扁平圆盘、一个三角指针和 12 个刻度构成场景；指针按固定角速度移动，圆盘边缘以呼吸式缩放表示时间流逝。第 7 秒太阳色点从左移到右，阴影随指针同步变化。保持正交相机和单一橙色强调色，不加入写实太阳或云层。
prompt_en: Create a 14-second abstract sundial. Use one flat disc, a triangular gnomon and 12 ticks; the gnomon moves at a fixed angular speed while the rim breathes subtly to show time passing. At 7s an orange sun dot moves from left to right and the shadow follows the gnomon. Keep an orthographic camera and one orange accent; no realistic sun or clouds.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_en: Three choices in a command palette
prompt_zh: 做一个可交互的命令面板练习。键盘输入会过滤 8 个固定命令，方向键移动高亮，Enter 触发选中项。每个状态都能由当前输入和固定列表重现，不使用不可见的随机状态。提供鼠标、键盘和触摸操作；在面板下方显示当前输入、匹配数量和动作结果。加入空结果、长文本和 Escape 关闭三个检查状态。自动演示镜头居中：0–3 秒输入、3–6 秒筛选、6–9 秒触发、9–12 秒展示空结果并关闭；使用固定输入序列和 render(t)，按事件播放合成点击与确认音。交付 16 张关键帧、HTML 源码和 12 秒 MP4。
prompt_en: Build an interactive command-palette exercise. Keyboard input filters eight fixed commands, arrow keys move the highlight and Enter activates the selected item. Reproduce every state from current input and the fixed list; use no hidden random state. Support mouse, keyboard and touch. Show current input, match count and action result below the panel. Include empty results, long text and Escape-to-close as inspection states. Center the demo camera: 0–3s type, 3–6s filter, 6–9s activate, 9–12s show empty results and close; use a fixed input script and render(t), with synthesized click and confirm cues on events. Deliver 16 keyframes, HTML source and a 12-second MP4.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一个 4×8 的节奏编辑器。点击格子切换开关，空格键开始和暂停，播放头按 100 BPM 移动。每个格子的声音使用短促合成音，音频时间和播放头共享同一时钟。显示当前拍号和活动格子数量，切换语言不重置节奏。支持键盘聚焦、可见焦点和移动端触摸，检查快速连续点击时没有重复事件。自动演示 12 秒：0–3 秒布置四拍、3–9 秒播放两轮、9–12 秒暂停并标注结果；由固定种子和 render(t) 重现，交付关键帧、可交互 HTML、无声预览和带合成声音的 MP4。
prompt_en: Build a 4×8 beat sequencer. Clicking a cell toggles it; Space starts and pauses; a playhead advances at 100 BPM. Each cell uses a short synthesized sound, sharing one clock with the playhead. Show beat number and active-cell count; language switching must not reset the pattern. Support keyboard focus, visible focus and touch, and verify rapid clicks do not create duplicate events. The 12-second demo sets four beats from 0–3s, plays two rounds from 3–9s, then pauses and labels the result from 9–12s. Reproduce it from a fixed seed and render(t); deliver keyframes, interactive HTML, a silent preview and an MP4 with synthesized sound.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 地图上的一条调查路线
title_en: One research route on a map
prompt_zh: 做一个可拖拽的抽象地图。地图由 12 个标记和 4 条路线组成，点击标记打开信息条，拖动改变视口，缩放限制在 0.8–2 倍。路线只使用项目内置的虚构地点，不暗示真实地理事实。每个标记提供键盘入口，视口变化显示缩放值，重置按钮恢复固定初始状态。自动演示镜头 0–4 秒从全图推近，4–8 秒拖过两条路线并打开一个标记，8–12 秒缩回并重置；拖动路径和缩放由固定事件表与 render(t) 决定，使用合成拖动与确认音，交付关键帧、HTML 和 12 秒 MP4。
prompt_en: Build a draggable abstract map with 12 markers and four routes. Clicking a marker opens an info strip; dragging changes the viewport; zoom is clamped between 0.8 and 2. Use fictional locations from the project only, with no implication of real geography. Give every marker a keyboard entry, show the zoom value as it changes and make Reset restore the fixed initial state. In a 12-second demo, push from the full map to a route at 0–4s, drag across two routes and open one marker at 4–8s, then pull back and reset at 8–12s. Derive drag and zoom from a fixed event table and render(t), use synthesized drag and confirm cues, and deliver keyframes, HTML and a 12-second MP4.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 两个滑块混合一种颜色
prompt_zh: 做一个颜色混合实验：两个滑块分别控制青色和橙色的比例，中心色块和十六进制值实时更新。滑块范围 0–100，使用线性插值，不使用颜色名称猜测。提供复制值按钮、重置按钮和高对比度预览。键盘调整时显示数值，窄屏下控件不横向溢出。把每次输入记录在一条简短的可清除历史中。自动演示 10 秒：0–2 秒建立初始色块，2–6 秒拖动两个滑块，6–8 秒复制值，8–10 秒重置；所有数值从固定输入和 render(t) 计算，拖动与复制播放合成短音，交付关键帧、HTML 和 MP4。
prompt_en: Create a color-mixing experiment with two sliders controlling cyan and orange ratios; update the central swatch and hex value live. Clamp both sliders to 0–100 and use linear interpolation rather than guessed color names. Include Copy value, Reset and a high-contrast preview. Show values during keyboard adjustment and keep controls inside a narrow viewport. Record each input in a short, clearable history. Make a 10-second demo: establish the swatch at 0–2s, drag both sliders at 2–6s, copy the value at 6–8s, and reset at 8–10s. Compute values from fixed input and render(t), add synthesized drag and copy cues, and deliver keyframes, HTML and an MP4.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一个队列调试器，提供 Enqueue、Dequeue、Pause 和 Reset 四个动作。队列最多 6 项，每项显示编号和进入时间；动作日志按时间顺序追加。暂停时不处理自动出队，恢复后继续固定间隔。所有状态都由操作序列重放得到，刷新后恢复为空。用颜色区分等待、处理中和完成，不用颜色作为唯一信息。自动演示 14 秒：0–3 秒入队三项，3–7 秒自动出队，7–10 秒暂停并追加两项，10–14 秒恢复后重置；使用固定操作表、render(t) 和合成入队/出队音，交付 16 张关键帧、源码和 MP4。
prompt_en: Build a queue debugger with Enqueue, Dequeue, Pause and Reset actions. The queue holds at most six items; each item shows an ID and entry time, and an ordered action log grows below. Pause stops automatic dequeue; Resume continues at a fixed interval. Recreate all state by replaying the operation sequence, and start empty after refresh. Use color plus labels for waiting, processing and done states. The 14-second demo enqueues three items at 0–3s, dequeues automatically at 3–7s, pauses and adds two at 7–10s, then resumes and resets at 10–14s. Use a fixed operation table, render(t) and synthesized enqueue/dequeue cues; deliver 16 keyframes, source and MP4.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一个可拖动排序的 6 项列表。拖动时显示插入位置、被推动的卡片和当前顺序；释放后用 180ms 的克制缓动落位。键盘用户可以用上下键移动项目，Space 抓取和放下。焦点、拖动和错误释放都要有文字反馈。不要用拖拽阴影遮住文字，移动端提供长按替代方案。自动演示镜头 0–3 秒建立列表，3–7 秒把第 2 项拖到第 5 项，7–9 秒键盘移动一项，9–12 秒展示错误释放并恢复；输入路径写在固定事件表中，由 render(t) 重现，使用合成抓取和落位音，交付关键帧、HTML 和 12 秒 MP4。
prompt_en: Build a six-item drag-sort list. During drag show insertion position, the displaced card and current order; on release settle with a restrained 180ms easing. Keyboard users move items with Up and Down, and Space picks up or drops. Provide text feedback for focus, drag and invalid release. Keep shadows from covering text and offer a long-press alternative on touch screens. In a 12-second demo, establish the list at 0–3s, drag item two to position five at 3–7s, move one item by keyboard at 7–9s, then show an invalid release and recovery at 9–12s. Store the input path in a fixed event table and reproduce it with render(t), adding synthesized grab and settle cues; deliver keyframes, HTML and an MP4.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一条 11 秒循环感动效，但首尾画面要明确匹配。24 个方格按行列延迟缩放，橙色波纹从左上角传到右下角再返回。波纹速度、方格大小和透明度都由一个周期函数计算；第 10 秒提前收束，最后 1 秒回到初始相位。不要加入相机抖动、粒子和渐变背景。
prompt_en: Create an 11-second motion study with a clear matching first and last frame. Twenty-four squares scale with row and column delays as an orange wave travels from top-left to bottom-right and back. Derive wave speed, square size and opacity from one periodic function; resolve early at 10s and return to the initial phase during the final second. No camera shake, particles or gradient background.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 用 15 秒区分队列容量和处理速度。两个并排队列使用相同的输入速率，一个容量大但处理慢，一个容量小但处理快。用顶部数字显示长度，用底部箭头显示处理速度。先让两队列都接收 5 项，再改变一个参数，最后给出一句结论：容量影响能暂存多少，速度影响多久处理完。
prompt_en: Use 15 seconds to distinguish queue capacity from processing speed. Two side-by-side queues receive the same input rate: one has more capacity but processes slowly, the other has less capacity but processes quickly. Show length as a top number and processing speed as a bottom arrow. Feed five items to both, change one parameter, then end with: capacity controls storage; speed controls completion time.

recipe.audio: original synthesized cues on the same timeline

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一条 13 秒空间构成动画。四面带有不同符号的墙从平面十字逐一折起，组成一个小房间；相机从俯视转到正面。每面墙的折叠轴清楚可见，最后一面墙完成时内部出现橙色灯点。墙面不使用贴图，只用符号和两种颜色；相机运动必须连续，不穿透几何体。
prompt_en: Create a 13-second spatial construction. Four walls carrying different symbols fold up from a flat cross into a small room while the camera moves from top view to front view. Make every hinge visible; when the final wall closes, an orange light appears inside. Use symbols and two colors instead of textures. Keep the camera continuous and prevent it from passing through geometry.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一个可配置的专注计时器，默认 25 分钟但演示模式允许切换到 25 秒。开始、暂停、跳过和重置四个动作，圆环显示剩余比例，页面标题同步显示剩余时间。刷新页面后计时暂停并保留最后状态；不允许后台标签页偷偷加速。提供减少动效模式下的静态进度和清晰的完成提示音。自动演示 15 秒：0–3 秒开始，3–7 秒推进，7–10 秒暂停，10–12 秒跳过，12–15 秒重置；使用固定时钟和 render(t) 重现，交付关键帧、可访问 HTML、无声版本和带合成完成音的 MP4。
prompt_en: Build a configurable focus timer, defaulting to 25 minutes with a 25-second demo mode. Provide Start, Pause, Skip and Reset; a ring shows remaining proportion and the document title mirrors remaining time. After refresh, pause and preserve the last state; do not accelerate in a background tab. Respect reduced motion with a static progress display and provide a clear completion cue. The 15-second demo starts at 0–3s, advances at 3–7s, pauses at 7–10s, skips at 10–12s and resets at 12–15s. Reproduce it with a fixed clock and render(t); deliver keyframes, accessible HTML, a silent version and an MP4 with a synthesized completion cue.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一条 13 秒视觉化音乐间隔。八个点按固定的音程比例排列，先单独亮起，再以线连接成两组三角形，最后旋转成一个星座。每个点的编号和比例始终可读，旋转只发生在点亮之后。声音使用八个短音符，音符与点的出现严格对齐。
prompt_en: Create a 13-second visual study of musical intervals. Eight dots use fixed pitch ratios; they light one by one, connect into two triangles and finally rotate into a constellation. Keep each number and ratio readable, and rotate only after the dots appear. Use eight short notes with exact alignment between sound and dot events.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 移动平均如何抹平噪声
title_en: How a moving average smooths noise
prompt_zh: 用 17 秒解释移动平均。上方显示一条带有固定尖峰的原始曲线，下方显示窗口大小为 3 的移动平均。窗口沿曲线移动时，当前 3 个值高亮，平均值在下方同步更新。最后比较窗口为 3 和 5 的结果，标出平滑更多但响应更慢。所有数据写在场景配置中，禁止随机噪声。
prompt_en: Explain a moving average in 17 seconds. Show a raw line with fixed spikes above a moving average using a window of three. As the window advances, highlight the current three values and update the average below. End by comparing windows of three and five, labeling the larger window as smoother but slower to respond. Put all data in scene configuration and use no random noise.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一条 19 秒抽象空间动画。一个中心磁体用黑色圆柱表示，三条橙色轨道围绕它弯曲；三个白色粒子沿轨道运行，速度不同但周期可计算。前 5 秒建立方向箭头，5–15 秒展示轨道关系，最后 4 秒拉远并标注这是场线示意，不是物理求解。使用固定视角和确定性轨道函数。
prompt_en: Create a 19-second abstract spatial animation. Represent a central magnet as a charcoal cylinder with three orange curved orbits; three white particles travel at different, computable periods. Establish direction arrows for 0–5s, show the orbit relationship for 5–15s, then pull back for four seconds and label it as a field-line schematic, not a physical solution. Use a fixed view and deterministic orbit functions.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
prompt_zh: 做一个 12 行的双语数据表，列为名称、状态、数值和更新时间。点击表头按升序或降序排序，键盘可以从表头进入并朗读排序状态；筛选框按名称过滤。使用内置演示数据，表格为空时给出明确提示。移动端把列转成可读的行卡片，数字使用等宽字体并避免截断。自动演示 12 秒：0–3 秒展示全表，3–6 秒按数值排序，6–9 秒筛选名称，9–12 秒清空并恢复；数据和操作来自固定配置与 render(t)，排序和清空播放合成确认音，交付关键帧、双语 HTML 和 MP4。
prompt_en: Build a bilingual 12-row data table with name, status, value and updated columns. Clicking a header toggles ascending or descending sort; keyboard users can enter headers and hear sort state; a filter searches names. Use built-in demonstration data and show a clear empty state. On mobile, turn rows into readable cards. Use tabular numerals and never truncate values. In a 12-second demo, show the full table at 0–3s, sort by value at 3–6s, filter by name at 6–9s, then clear and restore at 9–12s. Derive data and actions from fixed config and render(t), use synthesized confirm cues for sort and clear, and deliver keyframes, bilingual HTML and an MP4.
